provenance.sourceAccess: Exported from the official reports in webui-benchmarks. This download is a sanitized extract, not a raw-run archive.
missing: A public cross-framework raw-run archive is not embedded in this sanitized docs extract.
limitations: One measured server round does not estimate run-to-run variability. Zero MAD is not evidence of confidence or a statistically established winner.
Browser metrics describe 10 isolated runs. Reported MAD and p95 are descriptive, not confidence bounds; the raw samples are not available here.
Some renderer-private measurements are unavailable. Each row's notes disclose the available and unavailable sample counts; these medians do not all use 10 samples.
Lower memory use is not an overall performance score. JavaScript heap, renderer private bytes, LCP, and server throughput measure different things.
Server throughput uses 64 connections. Saturation warnings in individual notes identify still-rising 128-connection probes; these are not demonstrated maximum throughputs.
The progressive category retains each case's existing behavior, including buffered routes. The dedicated WebUI resumable async data-boundary workload was not measured.
This sanitized extract preserves the five displayed metrics and their notes. It omits bulk server telemetry and unsupported winner summaries; it is not a complete reproducibility package.

metrics.label: JavaScript heap
metrics.description: Post-readiness JavaScript heap after explicit Chromium garbage collection. This is not total browser memory.
metrics.methodology: Chromium 156.0.8078.4 · 1,440×900 viewport · 10 randomized cold-cache navigations · fresh foreground process/context/page per sample · native occlusion throttling disabled · no CPU or network throttling

metrics.label: Renderer private bytes
metrics.description: Private bytes attributed to the isolated Chromium renderer after readiness. This is separate from JavaScript heap.
metrics.methodology: Chromium 156.0.8078.4 · 1,440×900 viewport · 10 randomized cold-cache navigations · fresh foreground process/context/page per sample · native occlusion throttling disabled · no CPU or network throttling

metrics.label: Largest contentful paint
metrics.description: Pre-interaction LCP from navigation start in an unthrottled lab setup, not field Core Web Vitals.
metrics.methodology: Chromium 156.0.8078.4 · 1,440×900 viewport · 10 randomized cold-cache navigations · fresh foreground process/context/page per sample · native occlusion throttling disabled · no CPU or network throttling

metrics.label: Complete response
metrics.description: Dynamic SSR throughput with a fully collected HTML response. One measured round cannot establish run-to-run variability.
metrics.methodology: 100 todos · 13 component types · 32 warm structural variants · current UTC state materialized per request · 64 connections from 2 load workers · 1 server process/worker pinned to 1 CPU · 1 × 20 s measured round · dynamic SSR · natural bytes

metrics.label: Progressive response
metrics.description: Dynamic SSR throughput with each case's existing response behavior. Some cases remain buffered; see their notes.
metrics.methodology: 100 todos · 13 component types · 32 warm structural variants · current UTC state materialized per request · 64 connections from 2 load workers · 1 server process/worker pinned to 1 CPU · 1 × 20 s measured round · dynamic SSR · natural bytes
